title: Framework, Standards, Applications and Best practices of Responsible AI : A Comprehensive Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying Responsible AI (RAI) literature and frameworks that emphasize fairness constraints, diverse training data, and bias detection algorithms to prevent gender-based discrimination in domains like hiring and blockchain applications.

Surveying RAI literature and industry practices on mitigating racial and ethnic biases through data anonymization, continuous monitoring for demographic imbalances, and fairness evaluations across diverse population samples.
Reviewing ethical AI guidelines and governance frameworks that mandate equitable AI decision-making to ensure systems do not discriminate against individuals based on their socioeconomic backgrounds.
Reviewing literature on data diversification and algorithmic fairness audits in blockchain-based prediction models to prevent region-based biases and supplier favoritism in global supply chains.
